messages:
marta: Quick sync — we're doing a microlaunch + webinar next Wed. Need final copy for three landing lanes (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) and the launch post thread. Who owns what?
ryan: I can draft the launch post + Hosted hero. Thinking concise: "Ship LLM features faster — predictable latency and costs."
olivia: I'll do visual hero comps for both headline options. Want two tone directions: energetic (developer-first) and trust (enterprise).
sami: Benchmarks — can we commit to showing 99th pctl latency and cost per 1k tokens for the hosted profile? Will need numbers from infra by EOD Fri.
marta: Yes, include 99p latency + p50 and a tiny table. Also add a short methodology blurb: how we measured (seq len, batch sizes, model name).
ben (Growth Ops): On inbound routing: propose rules so leads go to different queues based on selected mode on form. Quick mapping: Hosted -> self-serve SDR, Dedicated -> AE, Private -> Enterprise security lead.
ryan: Love that. Can we also surface a CTA for "Compare modes" that opens an in-page modal with a 2-line differentiation and a demo request?
olivia: Modal copy: small bullets. I can mock screen and sample copy.
copybot: Suggestion: hero variants A/B test: A = "Developer-first inference that scales" B = "Predictable, economical inference for production"
ryan: Let's test B for enterprise traffic and A for product blog audiences.
sami: Webinar planning: format 30m + 15m Q&A. Titles: "Serving LLMs: from dev to production" or "Cut inference cost, keep latency: real benchmarks". Which resonates?
marta: Second title focuses the funnel on cost/latency benchmarks — good for gated webinar. First is broader for blog-driven signups.
ben (Growth Ops): For launch posts schedule: 1) teaser 5 days out, 2) benchmark snapshot 2 days out, 3) registration reminder day of. Can I get final quotes for the posts (1-2 lines each) by Monday?
ryan: I'll draft the teaser + day-of. Need a short pull-quote from Eng about the 99p latency improvement. @sami can you get that?
sami: Yep, pinging eng-runtime for the metric and a one-sentence quote.
olivia: Quick copy nit: keep hero verbs active and avoid "solution-y" wording. Example: instead of "reduces inference costs" use "lowers per-token cost by up to X%" (with numbers in the benchmark section).
marta: Good call. Also let's keep the three-mode nav copy explicit: Hosted (fastest time-to-value), Dedicated (predictable throughput), Private (VPC & on-prem). That helps routing.
ben (Growth Ops): Routing rules (rough):
```
form.mode = hosted => tag=hosted_lead; route=sdm_selfserve
form.mode = dedicated => tag=dedicated_lead; route=ae_queue
form.mode = private => tag=private_lead; route=enterprise_security_team
```
ben (Growth Ops): Also add UTM convention for posts: utm_source=launch, utm_medium=organic or social, utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch_v1
ryan: For the launch post thread copy (twitter/linkedIn): short hook + 1 benchmark stat + CTA to webinar and site. I'll share drafts here tomorrow.
copybot: Microcopy suggestion for CTAs: [Hosted] Try the API, [Dedicated] Request reserved capacity, [Private] Contact for private deployment
marta: Outstanding: who will own final proof/read? olivia can proof hero microcopy, ryan will own post copy, ben will set form routing. I'll collate and publish the canonical copy doc in the Google drive.
ryan: One more ask — can we include a short FAQ snippet on the landing that addresses "How is Private different from Dedicated?" 2-3 bullets. I'll draft.
sami: Confirming timeline: bench numbers by Fri, copy drafts Mon, visual comps Tue, finals Wed morning -> publish by Wed afternoon.
olivia: Locked in — I'll push comps into the design folder and ping here when ready.
marta: Great. Stretch goal: create a single succinct 2-line description that can be used across hero, webinar intro, and social. Try to keep under 140 chars.
ben (Growth Ops): I'll wire up the initial form and routing rules to a test endpoint so we can QA before publish.
ryan: Thanks team. Quick action items: Sami (eng quote + bench numbers), Olivia (hero comps + modal mock), Ben (form routing + UTMs), Ryan (launch posts + Hosted hero), Marta (collate + final approval).
marta: Awesome — let's reconvene Tue morning if any blockers. :thumbsup:
